summary: Platform for running and interacting with large language models locally, supporting a wide variety of models like Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and others via a simple API.
usecases: Local LLM inference for privacy-focused applications
Rapid prototyping and testing of different LLMs without cloud dependencies
Integration into desktop or mobile apps for AI chat capabilities
ideas: Build a local AI assistant that runs entirely offline on consumer hardware
Create a model router that automatically selects the best model for a given task from the supported list
Integrate with edge devices for on-device AI features without internet
